svg.title: keelinfra: CI that can't upgrade yet, kept running
svg.desc: Upstream Jenkins moves from 2.541.3 on Java 17 to 2.555.1 and 2.580.2 on Java 21 only. keelinfra's 2.541.x line branches off at 2.541.3 and stays on Java 17 with later core security fixes, now at 2.541.3-k4. Below, build hosts on AIX, Solaris and HP-UX keep Java 8 and connect to a Java 21 controller through Agent8.
